criteria.deficiency: Non-blocking doc inaccuracy, not a convention deviation: generated/rich/progress.py:1232-1233 (Progress.open) and :1314-1315 (Progress.wrap_file) say 'The task is not started by this method'. Both call add_task with its default start=True (base/rich/progress.py:1002, :1034-1035), and start_task sets start_time (base/rich/progress.py:806-809), so the task is started. Behavior matches the reference, which makes no such claim.
